propositions: closing a bug --class not_a_bug without a replacement link currently routes to the completion verifier, which fails because it demands proof a defect was fixed when the RCA proves no defect existed

not_a_bug is in DISPOSITION_CLASSES but has no deterministic replacement path, so close_disposition.verdict() returns None and falls through to full verification instead of minting a signed attestation

not_a_bug and escalated must be added to REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES so --reason is mandatory and verdict() mints a deterministic (class, close_reason) attestation without invoking the completion verifier
a live replacement link should satisfy the reason requirement for not_a_bug and escalated (checked first via REPLACEMENT_SATISFIES_REASON_CLASSES), with --reason as the fallback path
write-time refusal via txn.close_class_refusal must enforce both reason and replacement paths, naming both doors when neither is provided, to prevent silent fall-through to verification
